title: It's Snow Bother
start: Talk to Santa Claus near his grotto in the Land of Snow's Christmas Village.

rewards.t: Winter Hat and Winter Scarf (green and red)
Ability to place a Christmas tree and other decorations in Fort Forinthry with Zoe
Santa's sack that allows the player to deliver one present a day in return for more Christmas spirit
Emotes from previous Christmas events (if not unlocked)
Access to the decoration making activity in the Christmas Village

steps.t: Talk to Santa Claus in the southern part of Christmas Village. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to the snow imp following you. [Chat: 1 It's Snow Bother quest.]
Investigate the Christmas spirit map south-east.
Create decorations at the decoration bench in Diango's Workshop to the east; you will fail.
Teleport to the Falador lodestone.
Search the sleigh just inside Falador's northern entrance.
Search five piles of snow (Object map | 2959,3377 | objectname=Missing Christmas decorations | type=maplink | text=show on map ):

sub.t: By Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.
North of the Estate agent's office.
On the White Knights' Castle bridge.

steps.t: Add decorations to the missing Christmas decorations just outside the Rising Sun pub.
Teleport to the Lumbridge lodestone.
Search the sleigh just to the south-east.
Search five piles of snow (Object map | 3232,3212 | objectname=Missing Christmas decorations | type=maplink | text=show on map ):

sub.t: By the bank chest in Lumbridge Market.
Inside the kitchen of the Lumbridge Castle.
Inside the northern room of eastern gatehouse of the Lumbridge Castle.

steps.t: Add decorations to the missing Christmas decorations just south of the Lumbridge lodestone.
Make your way to Varrock Square.
Search the sleigh near the Varrock Palace entrance.
Find the five piles of snow (Object map | 3220,3433 | objectname=Missing Christmas decorations | type=maplink | text=show on map ):

sub.t: Near Pelters' Veg Stall, behind Varrock General Store.

steps.t: Add decorations to the missing Christmas decorations in the north-eastern part of Varrock Square.
Teleport back to Christmas Village.
Investigate the Christmas spirit map.
Take Santa's request next to the map.
Make five of the following deliveries:

sub.t: You need to check Santa's sack in your backpack and choose a character in the interface before talking to them with the sack and some backpack space.

steps.t: Talk to Santa Claus in the southern part of Christmas Village to complete the quest.

get_inside.text: Christmas Village Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network.
Christmas Village portal north of the Grand Exchange.
Holiday portal in Tower of Voices.
Using the teleport option of Christmas wrapping paper, letter to Santa, or town crier.
Using the teleport option in the Calendar or event interfaces.
